latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ecommerce-scraper

- Dynamic e-commerce data scraper using Playwright to handle JavaScript-rendered pages.
- Supports Cloudflare anti-bot bypass, hidden API discovery, and pagination scraping.
- Suitable for Chinese (JD, Taobao, Pinduoduo) and international (Amazon, eBay) e-commerce platforms.
- Provides scripts for basic scraping, login-enabled scraping, API discovery, and Cloudflare bypass.
- Includes practical selectors for major platforms and troubleshooting guidance.
